questions.stem: All of the following are features of otitis media with effusion EXCEPT?

options.label: A
options.text: Most cases have Ad type of curve on tympanometry and a conductive hearing loss

options.label: B
options.text: Resolves on its own after the symptoms subside

options.label: C
options.text: Usually occurs after an episode of common cold, but can occur de-novo
